pages.title: Herbs
pages.text: Herbs are magical plants used throughout Hexalia in rituals, brews, infusions, and other mystical practices. Some are refined into powders or pastes, while others are valued in their natural form.

pages.title: Obtaining Herbs
pages.text: Herbs are not usually found growing naturally. Instead, they are obtained by using $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/mutation)Mutavis$(/l) on specific vanilla blocks in the world, causing hidden flora to emerge.

pages.title: Spirit Bloom
pages.text: Found through swamp-born growth, Spirit Bloom can be refined into Spirit Powder. It is commonly used in brews and in the workings of the Censer.

pages.title: Dreamshroom
pages.text: A rare fungal herb tied to altered sight and movement. It can be refined into Dream Paste and is used in effects linked to speed, vision, and dreams.

pages.title: Ghost Fern
pages.text: Ghost Fern yields Ghost Powder, a material associated with spectral, pacifying, and ethereal properties.

pages.title: Siren Kelp
pages.text: An aquatic herb refined into Siren Paste. Its uses are often tied to water, aquatic boons, and protection against flame.

pages.title: Witchweed
pages.text: A natural herb used directly as a crafting ingredient. Though simple in form, it appears in many foundational Hexalia recipes.

pages.title: Lotus Blossom
pages.text: A rare blossom used directly in crafting and other magical workings. Its value lies in its purity rather than refinement.

pages.title: Celestial Bloom
pages.text: Celestial Bloom holds starlit energy and is used in $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/celestial_infusion)Celestial Infusion$(/l) through the Ritual Brazier.
